chapter: Boyhood scene: halls and dance music
title: Italian brass bands and marching repertoire
summary: They discuss the Italian concert and brass band, which played marches and European dances but did not swing.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: He was pretty sick. Did they have any brass bands other than an Italian brass band?

That's the one I remember seeing in one of those, but I mean, it wasn't. Dozens of other colored brass bands. This big Italian band was somewhat of a concert and brass band, military band, all combined. They had the classics. Never heard them swing out much because that marsh they would do with either religious media parlor, just playing marching music.
I think they played a few dances, but they couldn't swing. They played everything when life was a march, you know. Tony Perrini was talking about that yesterday.

Yeah, well, they probably played in the Zerkers and Quadrilles and the Lancers, European type dances like you see in those student princess pictures, you know, that dance, and they'll tear it off. Awesome.
